name: Derived non-derived exclusion from derived filters
what_it_tests: A standard line (ItemIsDerived=false/null) must NOT enter Derived Pricing Filter, Derived Maintenance Net Filter, or Stamp Contributor Base derived branches; standard waterfall applies
proc_mechanism: Derived Pricing Filter / Derived Maintenance Net Filter (ItemIsDerived Equals true) exclude it; Stamp Base Filter ((ItemIsDerived IsNull OR =false)) includes it
expected_behavior: Standard waterfall applies; derived formula skipped
test_setup: Software line, ItemIsDerived=false, Qty=3, New quote

prior_run.actual: Static trace of LIVE V21 metadata confirmed the three derived gates are exactly ItemIsDerived__std Equals true and Stamp Base Filter is (IsNull OR =false) AND QuoteTypeText__c!='Renewal' AND ItemPricingSource!='LastTransaction' AND NetUnitPrice>0. Live Force-reprice of a real new-business standard non-derived Subscription line (BP-ETM-RMS-ADDITH, PBE 01uWC000005wrrIYAQ IsDerived=false, Fortra Price Book active, list 10000 USD, QuoteTypeText__c='New') through Active V21: isSuccess:true, errorResponse:[]; result NetUnitPrice=ListPrice=Base_Price__c=Pre_Partner_Price__c=10000, Source_List_Price__c=null -> standard waterfall ran (Stamp Base branch), derived branches skipped. Inverse control: real derived maintenance lines (PIA-PIA-RNM-PIAMBK, ItemIsDerived=true) carry Source_List_Price__c=355 and Base_Price__c=null (derived branch ran, standard skipped) -> the field split is the genuine disc…

prior_run.notes: Config/parity-style scenario validated per brief (existing real records + proc metadata + one live Force-reprice), no DML fixture. The gate field ItemIsDerived__std is sourced from PricebookEntry.IsDerived; all standard software/subscription/perpetual PBEs confirmed IsDerived=false. Quantity (test_setup says Qty=3) is immaterial to the routing claim - the gate is ItemIsDerived__std, not quantity; TotalPrice scales as NetUnitPrice*Qty regardless. Avoided the A-01/A-02 headless base-seed gap by using a UI-priced existing line rather than an Apex-inserted fresh line; the live Force-reprice preser…
